manifest.name: dsh-chat-widener
manifest.description: Widen the DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversation content area (shipped default 748px) by overriding the chat-width CSS variables; configurable via the plugin row config.
manifest.author: garrisonz

bundle.text:
# dsh-chat-width bundle patch: mounts the chat-width plugin into the web
# profile tree.
#
# Tune the content width (px) by overriding this row's config from the
# profile's own cordis.patch.yml (later layers win for the same row id), e.g.:
#
#   - id: chat-width
#     name: 'dsh-chat-widener'
#     config:
#       width: 1400
#
# To disable the plugin without uninstalling, set `disabled: true` on the row.
- insert:
    - id: chat-width
      name: 'dsh-chat-widener'
      config:
        width: 1200

readme.text:
Widen the DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversation content area. The shipped chat
column is 748px (`--dsh-chat-content-width`); this plugin overrides it — default
**1200px**, configurable — so messages, tables and the composer all render
wider (Doubao-web-style). Pure CSS injection, no host logic, no vendor-file
patching, survives dsh upgrades.

把 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 对话内容区加宽。官方对话列宽为 748px
（`--dsh-chat-content-width`），本插件默认覆盖为 **1200px**（可配置），
消息、表格与输入框一起变宽。纯 CSS 注入：无宿主逻辑、不打补丁、升级不失效。

| key | meaning / 含义 | default / 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| `width` | content width, px / 内容区宽度 | `1200` |

Sane range [748, 2400]; out-of-range values fall back to 1200.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-widener        # npm（发布后）

Edit `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: chat-width
  name: 'dsh-chat-widener'
  config:
    width: 1400

Restart to apply. / 重启生效。

readme.section: Preview without restart / 不重启预览

readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-chat-widener
```

No residue — the plugin only injects a `<style>` element at runtime.
无残留——插件只在运行时注入一个 `<style>` 元素。

This plugin's only job is the conversation content width. No buttons, no
persistence, no other surfaces. / 本插件唯一职责就是对话内容宽度：不加按钮、
不持久化、不涉及其他界面。
